_doc: Emberveil 2 lines spoken on arrival in a settlement (round 21, E39). Registered into the Lingo grammar at start-up by js/talk.js registerTownTalk(); each key is a grammar symbol spoken through Talk.line(), so the speaker's traits, tics and voice apply. Bindings from Talk.woundedLine(): hurt / down (an Entity whose name is one hero or a joined list, 'Corvin and Mirelle'), hurtCount, downCount, allHurt (nobody in the party is healthy, so the speaker is hurt too), town (the settlement's name). Every line has a cond that picks exactly one situation, so a list is never read with the wrong verb. Lines tagged 'healer' are only offered to a healer (js/talk.js speechFor role tags); every situation also has untagged lines for everyone else.

wounded_rest.t: We should take a rest, {hurt.name} is wounded.
{hurt.name} is bleeding through the wraps. We rest here tonight.
{hurt.name} won't say it, so I will. We need a night off the road.
Before we go anywhere, {hurt.name} needs a bed and a quiet night.
Sit down, {hurt.name}. I want a proper look at that wound before we leave {town.name}.
We should take a rest. {hurt.name} are wounded.
Half of us are held together with string. {hurt.name} need rest.
Nobody walks out of {town.name} like this. {hurt.name} are carrying wounds.
{hurt.name}, both of you, sit. We are resting before the road finishes the job.
I count too many wounds. {hurt.name} rest tonight, and I'm not asking.
{down.name} is down. The cleric here can get them back on their feet.
We can't carry {down.name} another mile. Find the cleric.
{down.name} is down. The cleric first, then anything else.
I did what I could for {down.name} on the road. The cleric can do the rest.
{down.name} are down. We need the cleric, now.
Get {down.name} to the cleric. Nothing else matters tonight.
Too many of us on stretchers. {down.name} go to the cleric before we do anything.
{down.name} is down and {hurt.name} is hurt. The cleric, then a bed.
{down.name} is down, {hurt.name} is not far behind. The cleric in {town.name} can see to both.
{down.name} is down and {hurt.name} are hurt. The cleric, then a long rest.
{down.name} is down. {hurt.name} are bleeding. We stop here and see the cleric.
{down.name} are down and {hurt.name} is hurt. We need the cleric.
{down.name} are down. {hurt.name} is barely standing. The cleric, now.
{down.name} are down and {hurt.name} are hurt. The cleric. Now.
Look at us. {down.name} are down, {hurt.name} are bleeding. The cleric before anything.
None of us is fit for the road. We rest in {town.name} tonight.
Every one of us is hurting, me included. A bed. Please.
We should take a rest. There isn't a whole one of us left.
{down.name} is down and the rest of us aren't much better. Find the cleric.
{down.name} are down and I can barely stand. The cleric, before we lose anyone.
We're all hurt, and {down.name} isn't standing at all. The cleric. Now.
We're all hurt, and {down.name} aren't standing at all. The cleric. Now.
